question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing '1' on it ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6f37d0d80fbdd5df5765bd7fe19e74669bb3b7aebea132108434c5cbf1f6d97.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As & is common on both the dices, it is clear that 2, #, 1, and 8 are adjacent to it, and the remaining will be opposite to it.

Opposite pairs: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ecbd3703e4c926251237c08e8cb537c35a8bdbd731739e5252eca1280968f7f.png] 

# → 8

2 → 1

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
